provenance.source: pg-router --help, first line: "usage: pg-router [--version | --help] [run ... | status [--json] ...]" and "pg-router routes typed events from configured sources through a durable queue to configured handler roles"

unknownFlag.source: pg-router --help: top level takes only [--version | --help]; --socket, --token and the run-scoped selectors belong to subcommands this spec does not model

pg-router --help: the dispatch verbs are the subcommands below; the top level takes no operand of its own (bare "pg-router" prints usage and exits non-zero)
